saw_lines: Nightwear is chosen by how it feels once the lights go out, then replaced only when it stops feeling right.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a buyer decides if the nighttime comfort is worth a click.
Your 30 ads carry no proof number, so buyers have nothing concrete to weigh. Pull one count, such as reviews collected or orders shipped, and print it on three video ads.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 31 Oct 2026
points: None of your 30 live ads shows a proof number, so a buyer on the fence has nothing concrete to weigh. Pull one count, such as reviews collected or orders shipped, and print it on the first frame of three video ads.

Your 27 copy ads open 15 different ways, and the biggest story leads only 6 of them, so buyers never hear the same pitch twice. Pick the two best openers and build your next batch from those two stories alone.

Four of your ads have run 60 days or longer, which gives you a working base. Build three more variations of the oldest winner, the all-time favourite video, changing only the opening frame so new buyers meet the proven story first.
Shop now sits on 28 of 30 ads, but 2 Learn more ads point to store pages, and that mismatch loses clicks. Give those 2 a store visit call and keep Shop now for product and collection pages.
